hypothesis: Broadcomの直近free cash flow成長優位は単四半期だけでなくTTMでもNVIDIAを上回り、AVGOの約4%高いTTM EV/FCFと約1.0 percentage point高い5年reverse-DCF implied FCF CAGR hurdleを正当化する持続的なcash-flow evidenceとして再利用できる。

decision_rule.use_or_condition_if: AVGOのTTM FCF growthがNVDAを少なくともbaseline reverse-DCF hurdle spread 0.9913 percentage points上回り、かつAVGOのTTM FCF marginが前年TTMから悪化しない。
decision_rule.reject_if: AVGOのTTM FCF growthがNVDAを上回らない、または単四半期の優位がTTMで反転する。

method.metric: issuer-reported free cash flow; TTM constructed only from disclosed fiscal-period FCF without interpolation

relative.ranking_flip: latest quarter: AVGO > NVDA; TTM: NVDA > AVGO

finding.summary: AVGOは最新四半期FCF growthではNVDAを35.88 points上回るが、TTM FCF growthでは58.05%に対しNVDA 76.50%で18.45 points下回った。AVGOのTTM FCF marginは41.60%から44.22%へ改善したものの、より高いEV/FCFとreverse-DCF growth hurdleを正当化する持続的な相対FCF成長優位は確認できない。
finding.production_action: AVGOの単四半期FCF +94.5%を5年valuationの擁護材料として単独使用しない。relative cash-flow allocation判断ではTTM FCF growthを最低限のquality gateに含める。

benchmark_and_alternative.interpretation: 単四半期だけではrelative growth rankingが不安定。

risk_and_limitations: FCF definitions are issuer-reported and may differ in detail between companies.
This is fundamental valuation evidence, not a historical trading strategy; Sharpe, Maximum Drawdown and Expected Shortfall are not decision-valid outputs for this test.
TTM growth is backward-looking and does not establish future five-year FCF CAGR.
NVIDIA TTM FCF margin declined despite faster FCF growth; Broadcom TTM FCF margin improved despite slower FCF growth, so growth and cash conversion must remain separate decision dimensions.

implementation.reason: Hypothesis rejected; persist only reusable negative evidence and a TTM quality gate.

next_high_value_hypothesis: Point-in-time quarterly reverse-DCF hurdleを各決算後に固定し、次の決算までの実現FCF growthでhurdle realizationをwalk-forward評価すると、NVDA/AVGOのlower-hurdle ruleはNVDA-onlyまたはequal-weightよりcost-adjusted returnとtail riskを改善するか。
